data.one_liner: A beautiful, animated bottom navigation bar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated bottom navigation bar that highlights selected items with color fills and smooth transitions. It uses the current theme by default while offering customizable styling parameters such as icon size, background color, elevation, and item padding.
use_when: You want a custom animated bottom navigation bar with highlighted active items.
Your application uses between two and five bottom navigation tabs.
avoid_when: You need more than five navigation items.
You prefer standard platform-native bottom navigation bars without custom animations.
strengths: Smooth and built-in animations for tab changes.
Extensive customization options including colors, shadows, and border radii.
Supports integration with PageView and PageController.
weaknesses: Limited to a maximum of five items per navigation bar.
Does not support more complex layouts or custom navigation routing out-of-the-box.
data.minimal_example:
BottomNavyBar(
   selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
   showElevation: true,
   onItemSelected: (index) => setState(() => _selectedIndex = index),
   items: [
     BottomNavyBarItem(icon: Icon(Icons.apps), title: Text('Home'), activeColor: Colors.red),
     BottomNavyBarItem(icon: Icon(Icons.people), title: Text('Users'), activeColor: Colors.purpleAccent),
   ],
)
